scope: Three client information features and their library; not full QoL parity or release acceptance.

initialRun.fixture: Backed-up superflat UI world; QA datapack grants containers, armor and Haste, changes mode to survival. Peaceful selected. Not natural acquisition.
observed: Filled shulker compact view shows 16 copper ingots, 8 bread and one compass. Empty blue shulker shows empty; no stale contents.
Equipment Compare renders worn iron chestplate +6 armor next to diamond +8 armor/+2 toughness. Equipped/Equipado badge translated; panels fit. No comparison on shulker.
EMI search prisa/haste opens a single JEED status-effect page with original description and provider list in both languages. No duplicate JEI category observed.
With EMI effect-location TOP, clicking the native active effect did not open the JEED page; search the virtual effect icon instead.
Sophisticated backpack opens with B and accepts an iron chestplate. Empty/filled hover is not taken over by Shulker even with temporary always-on enabled.
Saved all dimensions and exited normally at 06:10:20 Argentina.

temporaryRenderingSettings.reason: Sky has tap chords, no documented held-modifier input. These settings exercise rendering only.

defects.origin: Added JEED 1.21-2.3.4 serializer omits type=mob_effect. EMI 1.1.24 reads type before selecting a serializer.
defects.observedImpact: Language reload logs a caught NullPointerException in EmiSidebars.load; stored Haste lookup is discarded. Page itself still works.
defects.potentialImpact: Favorites and hidden effects use the same serializer; not separately exercised.
defects.dataPolicy: No user histories/favorites cleared or rewritten.
defects.fix: Optional client-only companion mixin adds type=mob_effect to JEED serializer output only when absent; no hard JEED/EMI dependency and no history migration.

defects.origin: Accessories embedded in pinned Aether and existing Curios each emit a Back slot line; backpack has both item tags.
defects.observedImpact: Two slot labels, including Accessories English fallback in Spanish. No additional container panel from this batch.
defects.configFinding: Accessories showEquippedStackSlotType governs experimental equipped UI, not this tooltip callback; no suitable config fix found.

limits: Held Shift/Alt/Ctrl, full slot-preserving preview, preview locking, physical EN/ES keyboard layouts and screen-edge placement are pending.
Sophisticated held-Shift contents preview and a modded effect without a description are pending.
No new dedicated-server run: dependency set unchanged and additions are client-only.
No FPS/TPS, memory-soak, survival pacing, final artwork, six-player or public CurseForge acceptance claimed.
This batch changes no quests or campaign IDs. Prototype remains 171 quests in seven chapters and 42 milestones.
Full-pack dedicated server was not rerun for this client-only patch; the isolated 30-test dedicated server passed without JEED/EMI. Separate favorite/hidden-effect persistence remains untested.

sourceValidation.runtimeMixinApplication: Verified: new Haste query gains discriminator, reload parses it, unrelated bread query resaves it intact.

regressionRun.plainHoverAfterRestart: Diamond chestplate has no comparison panel; filled shulker has a Shift hint and no expanded preview. Temporary QA settings are restored.
regressionRun.oldMalformedEntry: One startup error at 06:23:32 from the previously saved Haste record without type. EMI omitted this record; the fix does not edit old data.
regressionRun.newQuery: Opened Haste in EMI; emi.json now contains type=mob_effect.
regressionRun.reload: F3+T from the world; EMI finished reloading at 06:26:23 without another deserialization error.
regressionRun.memoryRoundTrip: After reload, queried bread without reopening Haste. EMI resaved bread followed by the intact Haste object, proving the effect survived in-memory loading.
regressionRun.normalShutdown: All dimensions saved; client stopped normally at 06:28:34 Argentina. History retained after shutdown.
regressionRun.otherDiagnostics: Two INFO-level OpenGL debug reports at 06:22:52 say depth formats do not match. No visible corruption in inspected screens; origin/performance impact not established.
